description: Find a topic across every search index installed on this computer (ULT, Westminster, Schaff, and any other Search zip from the catalog). BM25 keyword + Granite vectors, fused with RRF. Use this for "verses about hope" or "perfect in holiness". For an exact Bible substring, search_lexical. Errors if the model is missing -- then install ["search-en-ult"]. Install the other search ids, or ["all"], to include them.

limit.description: Hits to keep from each installed index. Default 8. The total grows with how many indexes are installed

query.description: Topic or question, like God comforting those who mourn

name: search_vector
